items.text: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling had ankle surgery, will miss close to 10 weeks (late Nov/early Dec return). Tonges also season MCL.
items.why: Deltoid repair for full recovery; ~10 weeks.
items.implication: Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson clear beneficiaries/waiver targets.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday practice, but expects to play Sunday at Houston. Got mental reps.
items.why: Player statement of back tightness but plans to play.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday; CIN pass game (Chase/Higgins) full go if active.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury. No plans to place on IR.
items.implication: Drew Lock starts; impacts SEA pass-catchers and matchup vs ARI.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (rib) will not practice Wednesday; early negative sign. Status up in air for Week 2.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; missed Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Monitor; Tre Harris primary beneficiary if out. Johnston/others elevated.

items.text: Ravens placing rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.why: Wrist fracture surgery to accelerate recovery; 4-game minimum.
items.implication: Opens targets for Bateman/Moore; Flowers status separate.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant in Wednesday practice; indication he could return Sunday.
items.implication: Potential committee return; Stevenson remains lead but Henderson upside if shares grow.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor; could elevate other DEN RBs if limited/out.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for season after MCL tear surgery. Placed on IR; Hodge promoted, Stoll signed.
items.implication: Kittle (if healthy) or other TEs full TE role; minimal fantasy TE depth hit if Kittle back.

items.text: Vikings placed RB Jordan Mason (thumb) on IR, signed DeeJay Dallas. Small fracture fixed; short-term IR, expected back quickly per O'Connell.
items.why: Thumb fracture surgically fixed; 4-week IR minimum but optimistic return.
items.implication: Aaron Jones/others elevated short-term; Dallas depth.

items.text: Travis Hunter played only four specialized offensive snaps in Week 1 (jet sweep, bubble/tunnel screens, decoy); did not pass LOS on a route. Jaguars' offseason actions (Meyers extension, BTJ interest) make limited offensive role clear intention.
items.why: Extremely specialized package with zero traditional routes; team prioritized other WRs.
items.implication: Not a reliable fantasy starter early; long-season upside remains but role limited now.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid Stribling long-term absence.
items.why: Stribling surgery creates clear path to increased role/targets in SF offense.
items.implication: Priority add; immediate WR3/flex upside with path to more.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes/targets with Stribling out long-term

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finished 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving role with Mahomes; high opportunity share and efficiency.
items.implication: Locked RB1 ROS; start every week regardless of matchup.
items.opportunity: 29/32 early opps, 19 routes, 6 targets, goal-line/receiving work

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied for No. 1 Utilization Score at RB (99) in Week 1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes into 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 2 TDs, 156 scrimmage yds. Upgrades to high-end RB1 every-down player.
items.why: Dominant three-down role and efficiency behind improved OL; historical comps elite.
items.implication: RB1 lock ROS; start with confidence.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate usage even with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4. Surprising committee.
items.why: Shared workload despite Kamara absence; low route share relative to snaps.
items.implication: Low-end RB2; Kamara return further clouds role. Miller handcuff/beneficiary.
items.opportunity: 43% attempts, 38% routes despite lead snaps; Miller 9 carries
